use default

struct RATIONAL is
    numerator: bigint
    denominator: bigint

    init(numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint) is
        let common =
            bigint.greatest_common_divisor(numerator, denominator)
        let sign = if denominator < 0n then -1n else 1n fi

        self.numerator = sign * numerator / common
        self.denominator = sign * denominator / common
    si

    +(other: RATIONAL) -> RATIONAL =>
        RATIONAL(
            numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator,
            denominator * other.denominator)

    *(other: RATIONAL) -> RATIONAL =>
        RATIONAL(numerator * other.numerator,
                 denominator * other.denominator)

    to_string() -> string =>
        if denominator =~ 1n then
            "{numerator}"
        else
            "{numerator}/{denominator}"
        fi
si

whole(value: bigint) -> RATIONAL => RATIONAL(value, 1n)

binomial(upper: int, lower: int) -> bigint =>
    (1::lower)
        |> reduce(1n, (running, step) =>
            running * bigint(upper - lower + step) / bigint(step))

bernoullis(count: int) -> List[RATIONAL] is
    let values = LIST[RATIONAL]()

    for index in 0::count do
        if index == 0 then
            values.add(whole(1n))
        else
            let total =
                (0..index)
                    |> reduce(whole(0n), (running, step) =>
                        running +
                            whole(binomial(index + 1, step)) * values[step])

            values.add(whole(-1n) * total * RATIONAL(1n, bigint(index + 1)))
        fi
    od

    values[1] = RATIONAL(1n, 2n)

    values
si

let bernoulli = bernoullis(20)

faulhaber_row(power: int) -> List[RATIONAL] =>
    (1::power + 1)
        |> map(exponent => (
            let index = power + 1 - exponent

            RATIONAL(binomial(power + 1, index), bigint(power + 1)) *
                bernoulli[index]
        ))
        |> collect()

write_line("the first ten rows of Faulhaber's triangle:")

(0..10)
    |> each(power => (
        let cells = faulhaber_row(power) |> map(cell => "{cell,8}")

        write_line("  {cells |> join("")}")
    ))

let row = faulhaber_row(17)

let total =
    row
        |> index()
        |> reduce(whole(0n), (running, cell) =>
            running +
                cell.value * whole(bigint.pow(1000n, cell.index + 1)))

write_line()
write_line("using row 18, the sum of k^17 for k = 1 to 1000:")
write_line("  {total}")
